1.1.0: Your Lareon account now does a lot more. Right-click a tab to send it to another device, save it to a reading list, email it to yourself, or jot a note about the site.
New Lareon cloud panel in the toolbar (Ctrl+Shift+L): your devices, reading list, collections, notes, and Ask Aster about the page you are on.
Save your open tabs as a collection and open them all again on any device.
Your unread Fledge mail count shows on the mail button.
Ember settings now live in your Lareon account on lareon.org, under Ember. Focus sites sync too.
Sharing your open tabs with your other devices is off by default and never includes private tabs.
One Lareon badge on the address bar instead of two.
1.0.3: Ember Sync: sign in with your Lareon account in Settings and your bookmarks, pinned sites and preferences follow you to every device.
Ember now opens Fledge, Lareon’s email, from the sidebar.
Pin tabs, snooze them for later, or make them temporary. Right-click a tab.
A plain-English site check on the lock: what to watch for, plus Forget this site.
Safer downloads: warnings for files pretending to be something else.
Calm mode, focus sessions, reader view and clean links.
Settings (Ctrl+,), a bookmarks bar, and bookmark import from Chrome, Edge or Brave.
Type maths or conversions like 18% of 240 or 5 miles to km in the address bar.
0.9.6: Ember now shows what’s new after it updates, like this window.
Clicking Restart now in the update window restarts Ember right away.
0.9.7: Find in page: press Ctrl+F to search the page you’re on.
Bookmarks: press Ctrl+D or tap the star in the toolbar, and find them in the Library.
Right-click menu: open links in a new tab, copy, paste, search for selected text and more.
Mute any tab that’s playing sound with the speaker icon on the tab.
Tab search: press Ctrl+Shift+A to jump to any open tab.
Clear data: in the Library, clear history, cookies and cache whenever you like.
1.0.6: Focus mode now shows a full-page screen when you open a paused site.
Signing in with Lareon shows its code only when the page asks you to confirm it.
1.0.7: On Mac, Get the update now downloads the new version, checks it, and opens the installer for you.
Ember cleans up the downloaded installer the next time it starts.
Focus mode now reliably shows its full-page screen on a paused site.
Pages no longer show a code -118 error after sitting idle; Ember quietly retries.
A new, friendlier screen when Lareon is having trouble.
1.0.8: Signing out of your Lareon account on lareon.org now signs Ember out too, and Ember notices within a minute.
Signing out of Ember also signs out the Lareon pages it opened.
Just one Lareon trusted badge in the address bar.
